import math
import factors


def factor_ma(bars, n):
    """n-day simple MA of close, or nan if history too short."""
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    return factors.sma(arr, n)


def factor_breakdown(bars):
    """Confirmed breakdown: close >4% below 100d MA and 20d trend slope negative."""
    close = bars["close"]
    ma100 = factor_ma(bars, 100)
    if math.isnan(ma100) or ma100 <= 0:
        return False
    slope = factors.trend_slope(bars, n=20)
    if math.isnan(slope):
        return False
    return close[-1] < ma100 * 0.96 and slope < 0


def factor_reentry(bars):
    """Re-entry: close back above 50d MA, or a fresh 20d breakout with positive momentum."""
    close = bars["close"]
    ma50 = factor_ma(bars, 50)
    if not math.isnan(ma50) and ma50 > 0 and close[-1] > ma50:
        return True
    brk = factors.donchian_breakout(bars, n=20)
    mom = factors.mom_skip(bars, n=120, skip=10)
    if brk == 1 and not math.isnan(mom) and mom > 0:
        return True
    return False


def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 30:
        return "HOLD"

    if account["position"] == 0:
        if factor_reentry(bars):
            return ("BUY", "re-entry: above 50d MA or 20d breakout with positive 12-1 momentum")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        if factor_breakdown(bars):
            return ("SELL", "confirmed breakdown: >4% below 100d MA with negative 20d slope")
        return "HOLD"

import math
import factors


def factor_ma50(bars):
    """50-day simple MA of close, or nan if history too short."""
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    return factors.sma(arr, 50)


def factor_ma50_rising(bars):
    """Whether the 50d MA is higher than 5 days ago (trend still intact)."""
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    ma_now = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    if math.isnan(ma_now):
        return False
    ma_prev = factors.sma(arr[:-5], 50)
    if math.isnan(ma_prev):
        return True
    return ma_now > ma_prev


def factor_trend_broken(bars):
    """Genuine break: close >3% below 50d MA AND 50d MA no longer rising."""
    close = bars["close"]
    ma50 = factor_ma50(bars)
    if math.isnan(ma50) or ma50 <= 0:
        return False
    return close[-1] < ma50 * 0.97 and not factor_ma50_rising(bars)


def factor_trend_ok(bars):
    """Re-entry: close back above its 50d MA."""
    close = bars["close"]
    ma50 = factor_ma50(bars)
    if math.isnan(ma50) or ma50 <= 0:
        return False
    return close[-1] > ma50


def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 30:
        return "HOLD"

    if account["position"] == 0:
        if factor_trend_ok(bars):
            return ("BUY", "close back above 50d MA")
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        if factor_trend_broken(bars):
            return ("SELL", "close >3% below 50d MA and MA falling")
        return "HOLD"

import math
import factors


def factor_trend_ok(bars):
    """Price above its 50d MA (fallback 200d): simple, fast trend filter to stay invested."""
    close = bars["close"]
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    ma50 = factors.sma(arr, 50)
    if not math.isnan(ma50) and ma50 > 0:
        return close[-1] > ma50
    ma200 = factors.sma(arr, 200)
    if not math.isnan(ma200) and ma200 > 0:
        return close[-1] > ma200
    return False


def factor_trend_broken(bars):
    """Clear trend break: price below 200d MA AND negative 50/200 cross."""
    close = bars["close"]
    arr = factors.arr(bars, "close")
    ma200 = factors.sma(arr, 200)
    if math.isnan(ma200) or ma200 <= 0:
        return False
    below = close[-1] < ma200
    cross = factors.ma_cross(bars, fast=50, slow=200)
    if math.isnan(cross):
        return below
    return below and cross < 0.0


def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)

v001initial · written 2024-11-01 (2024-W44) · parent -live 2024-11-01 → 2024-12-13 (30 sessions): +1.28% vs buy & hold +10.08% (alpha -8.81 pp)
I use a trend-following core (price above its 200-day average and a positive 50/200 MA cross) combined with a momentum confirmation (12-1 momentum and MACD histogram) to stay long in uptrends, and exit on a trend break or a sharp drawdown from the recent high. This suits a large-cap like MSFT where long uptrends dominate, while the drawdown stop limits damage in regime shifts. I would change it if backtests show the trend filter whipsaws or if mean-reversion signals prove more predictive for this stock.
import math
import factors


def factor_trend_stack(bars):
    """Blend of price-vs-200d-MA, 50/200 MA cross and 12-1 momentum: positive = healthy uptrend."""
    close = bars["close"]
    if len(close) < 210:
        return float("nan")
    ma200 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 200)
    if math.isnan(ma200) or ma200 <= 0:
        return float("nan")
    above = close[-1] / ma200 - 1.0
    cross = factors.ma_cross(bars, fast=50, slow=200)
    mom = factors.mom_skip(bars, n=120, skip=10)
    if math.isnan(cross) or math.isnan(mom):
        return float("nan")
    return 0.5 * above + 0.25 * cross + 0.25 * mom


def factor_pullback_health(bars):
    """Distance from 60-day high minus drawdown: small pullbacks in an uptrend are buyable."""
    dh = factors.dist_high(bars, n=60)
    dd = factors.drawdown(bars, n=250)
    if math.isnan(dh) or math.isnan(dd):
        return float("nan")
    return dh - dd


def decide(bars, account):
    close = bars["close"]
    n = len(close)
    if n < 210:
        return "HOLD"

    trend = factor_trend_stack(bars)
    macd = factors.macd_hist(bars, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9)
    dd = factors.drawdown(bars, n=250)
    ma200 = factors.sma(factors.arr(bars, "close"), 200)

    if math.isnan(trend) or math.isnan(macd) or math.isnan(dd) or math.isnan(ma200):
        return "HOLD"

    price = close[-1]
    above_ma = price > ma200

    if account["position"] == 0:
        if above_ma and trend > 0.0 and macd > 0.0 and dd > -0.15:
            return ("BUY", "uptrend: price>MA200, trend stack %.3f, MACD hist %.4f" % (trend, macd))
        return "HOLD"
    else:
        if (not above_ma) or trend < -0.02 or dd < -0.20:
            return ("SELL", "trend break: above_ma=%s trend=%.3f dd=%.3f" % (above_ma, trend, dd))
        return "HOLD"
